additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466098-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / S9 170004060] Check on logs CRM:00263000231
additional_info.body:
Good morning Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0466098.
I received the ticket with the analysis provided by my colleague, and I would like to follow up on the analysis:
The charger has the following configuration in regards of OCPP connector IDs: DC1 is Conenctor ID 1 and DC2 is connector ID 2
At 2025-12-05T16:04:23 user authenticated via App for outlet 1, but connected DC2:
Again, at 2025-12-05T16:06:55 user authenticated remotely for outlet 1, but at 2025-12-05T16:07:15 he connected DC2.
The failed sessions are due to the wrong authorization form the user.
Since there is no issue and no further analysis required, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
